pricing.page_description: Public catalogue of the plans on sale, with a comparison and billing questions.
pricing.title: Plans that grow with your workspace
pricing.subtitle: Start free, add members when your team grows. Prices exclude VAT and you can change plan any time.
pricing.empty_title: No plans are on sale yet
pricing.empty_description: Come back soon, or sign in if you already have an account.

reassurance.cancel: Change plan or move to free any time

compare.title: Compare plans
compare.description: Every limit, side by side. Values marked “Unlimited” have no cap.
compare.money_back_tooltip: Ask for a refund from Billing within {days} days of your first payment.
compare.footnote: Prices exclude VAT. Plans billed per member charge every member; members added during a period are prorated.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.renewal: Paid plans renew every month or every year from the day you subscribe.
billing.seats: Plans billed per member charge each member; a member added during a period is prorated on the next invoice.

vat.question: Is VAT included?
vat.answer: No, prices exclude VAT. It is added to each invoice according to your billing country.

cancel.question: Can I change plan or stop paying any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. Move to another plan or to the free plan from Billing: a cheaper plan starts at the end of the period you paid for, and your data stays. If you delete the workspace, its data is kept for {days} days, then deleted.

money_back.question: Is there a money-back guarantee?
money_back.window: Paid plans come with a {days}-day money-back guarantee, counted from your first payment. Request it from Billing: the subscription ends there and then.
money_back.prorated: You are refunded for the unused part of the period.

closing.title: Not sure which plan fits?
closing.description: Start on {plan} and upgrade from Billing when you need to. Your data comes with you.
